evidence: Governance audit during INIT-001 identifying risk of narrative G4 assertions without machine-readable evidence.
reproduction: Candidate verification attempted without generating or validating report.json.
root_cause: Absence of automated report generator allowing narrative claims to masquerade as verified gates.

evidence: Governance audit identifying risk of submitting prior commit report.json to bypass candidate checks.
reproduction: Submit report.json with tested_sha differing from active git HEAD.
root_cause: Evidence validator omitting git HEAD commit equality check against report.tested_sha.

evidence: Specification link audit during INIT-001 identifying broken relative links after documentation renaming.
reproduction: spec_validator parsing markdown relative paths and anchors.
root_cause: Absence of automated link integrity checker during documentation refactoring.

evidence: Observed legacy packaging in com.yugong.Backome bundled closed-source vendor binaries (REF-RE-01 Section 6.1) as documented in RE reference material.
root_cause: Legacy architecture bundled closed-source proprietary binaries rather than clean-room open-source implementations; recorded as reference baseline, not as licensing violation claim or application defect.

evidence: Legacy APK AndroidManifest.xml configured android:usesCleartextTraffic=true globally (SEC-01 in REF-RE-01).
root_cause: Legacy application disabled transport security globally to allow unencrypted communication.

evidence: Bytecode proves outbound WebSocket commands transmit flat state, whereas early notes assumed desired wrapper (REG-01 in RE_BASELINE.md).
reproduction: Compare Dalvik bytecode in websocket transmission against REST timer payload.
root_cause: Initial reverse engineering documentation conflated WebSocket wire format with REST schedule countdown schema.

evidence: Bytecode proves binary SLAM maps decompress with java.util.zip.Inflater (ZLIB header), refuting early GZIP claims (REG-04 in RE_BASELINE.md).
reproduction: Decompile MapPacketDecoder.java and observe Inflater usage.
root_cause: Early architectural report erroneously assumed GZIP stream format without bytecode confirmation.

evidence: Bytecode in bluetooth.c.E proves hardcoded 86-char slice capacity (128 buffer - 42 envelope), refuting MTU-10 variable slicing (REG-03 in RE_BASELINE.md).
reproduction: Inspect constant f41938j in decompiled bluetooth.c.E.
root_cause: Speculative formula MTU-10 assumed negotiated MTU was used for packet fragmentation when bytecode hardcoded buffer size.

evidence: Static scan of entire DEX string pool returned 0 occurrences of 192.168.200.1 or 192.168.10.1 (REG-02 in RE_BASELINE.md).
reproduction: Search DEX string pool in decompiled codebase.
root_cause: Early unverified engineering assumptions introduced speculative subnet IPs not present in legacy firmware/app.

evidence: Audit of network communications in bytecode found 0 evidence of robot exposing HTTP services on port 8000 (REG-05 in RE_BASELINE.md).
reproduction: Search network socket invocations across decompiled codebase.
root_cause: Speculative assumption that robot hosted an internal web server on port 8000.
